o1: Enables receptor ligand activity. Predicted to enable cytokine activity and frizzled binding activity. Involved in nematode male tail tip morphogenesis; neuron migration; positive regulation of cell projection organization; and the establishment or maintenance of cell polarity. Predicted to be located in extracellular region. Predicted to be active in extracellular space. Is expressed in several structures, including P6.pa; anchor cell; hypodermis; rectal epithelial cell; and tail. Predicted to interact with LIN-17. Is part of the Wnt/planar cell polarity signaling pathway. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in ectodermal dysplasia (multiple); obesity; oral squamous cell carcinoma; split hand-foot malformation 6; and tooth agenesis. Orthologous to several human genes including WNT10A (Wnt family member 10A); WNT10B (Wnt family member 10B); and WNT11 (Wnt family member 11).
